title: Replace mandatory planet node expansion with indexed PBF lookups
description: User wants to avoid the ~167.6 GB planet_nodes.bin intermediate, potentially processing/discarding chunks. Current Build All expands every source node to 16-byte id/lat/lon records; nodes can be referenced by later ways, so use-once deletion is unsafe. Proposed replacement: scan original PBF once to persist node-ID ranges and compressed block offsets, validate ordering/source identity, and resolve batched way dependencies from original compressed blocks through a bounded decoded-block cache. Existing osmpbf 0.2.8 BlobReader supports seekable_from_path/blob_from_offset; its IndexedReader also demonstrates block ID-range indexing. Keep original PBF during building; evict decoded blocks without deleting the sole remaining source. Benchmark index size/startup, cold/warm lookup throughput, memory and end-to-end build time before making it default. Verify exact geometry/feature parity, boundary/shared nodes, missing IDs, out-of-order inputs, stale index detection and durable source-aware resume. Do not delete or rewrite existing node stores/checkpoints during implementation; existing flat-store builds need explicit compatible migration/reset. Regional dependency-complete builds are a fallback, with extra source scans and boundary duplication. No implementation or cleanup has been performed for this proposal.
notes: Implemented optional indexed-PBF storage in CLI/Full Planet GUI. Resumable SQLite block descriptors + original-PBF coordinate reads; per-session 16 MiB LRU plus bounded grouped way-reference prefetch. Isolated indexed-pbf-v1 state, OS lock, source identity/settings binding; existing flat files/checkpoints preserved. All-feature exact normalized parity across 3 Hilbert extracts, 3 runs/mode: CA 17.97MB -> 12.36KB scratch, median 0.20s -> 0.22s; Delhi 88.67MB -> 36.94KB, 1.35s -> 3.45s; Colombia 45.02MB -> 24.65KB, 0.72s -> 2.07s. Grouping improved initial Delhi compact 8.85s to 3.45s. Compact trades disk for CPU/RAM; remains opt-in. docs/compact-node-lookup.md and disposable benchmark script reproduce results. Source on Hilbert, outputs/internal temp, OS caches not purged; no full-planet forecast/job. Workspace tests pass; added source/index corruption, interrupted scan resume, lock, prefetch eviction/limits, ordinary+dense full output/legacy preservation tests. Default-promotion/planet-scale performance follow-up 1kee-7o5; pre-existing output durability 1kee-0ke stays open.
close_reason: Shipped and validated optional compact PBF node storage with exact output parity, resumable indexing and preserved legacy state. More than 99.9% smaller regional node scratch; throughput/default promotion tracked separately in 1kee-7o5.

title: Make planet cell updates and resume state durable and source-aware
description: Review found existing correctness/performance gaps outside the node-speed change: cell writers overwrite files directly with fs::write, while checkpoint files are synced separately; the merge skip compares only feature counts, so changes to existing IDs can be skipped; checkpoint identity does not bind the input snapshot, enabled layers, or output root, and completion resets pass2_offset to zero so later runs scan ways again. Add atomic/durable output publication and job identity/completion tracking, with interrupted-write and same-ID update tests. A durable delta staging layer can also reduce repeated full-cell read/merge/rewrite work without losing resume safety.

title: Ocean tiles pulse forever in local mode (no SRTM source = treated as failed build)

The dissolve pulse grid therefore replays its 7s cycle forever over open water, and the CACHE card never reaches its total. Ocean tiles also keep consuming bounded build slots on retry, delaying real land tiles.

title: Uncapped local-terrain layers can exceed wgpu 256MB index buffer and panic
description: Crash: 'In Device::create_buffer, label = egui_index_buffer, Buffer size 329136408 is greater than the maximum buffer size (268435456)' after app left open overnight. road_layer.rs has MAX_MAJOR/MINOR_RENDER_POINTS_TOTAL budgets, but building_layer, tree_layer, waterway_layer, infra_layer, and power_layer paint every cached feature with no cap (building_layer.rs draw loop). Caches invalidate on osm_ingest::road_data_generation() bumps, so a background ingest progressively refills these layers with more geometry for the same viewport until one frame's egui mesh exceeds the wgpu max buffer size and panics. Fix: port the road layer's render-point budget to the other five cell layers; consider a frame-level guard in the egui-wgpu integration as defense in depth.

title: Optimize cache-builder output and terrain pipelines
description: Remove output-neutral wasted work, reduce node lookup and cell compaction I/O, improve resumability, and reuse terrain sampling resources without changing emitted geometry or raster fidelity.
notes: Implemented cache-builder optimization slice: (1) NodeLookup lookup_many groups way references by sparse-index block and reuses one buffer per block; planet Pass 2 now uses it. (2) Pass 1 node checkpoints flush and sync data before atomic checkpoint replacement; final EOF checkpoint prevents tail duplication; SQLite bbox node rows plus offset and completion plus clear now commit atomically with sparse-area checkpoint cadence. (3) Incremental 1kc merges preserve existing baked elevation arrays and sample only missing or new values; no elevation fields were removed. Follow-up resume correction: NodeWriter append receives the checkpoint record count, validates the file is not shorter, truncates any OS-flushed tail beyond that count, then replays from the PBF checkpoint. title: Bound persistent terrain cache growth and support space reclamation
description: The persistent Earth contour SQLite cache is about 265+ GiB and filled Hilbert while building new regions. Explicitly approved cleanup recovered 2.22 GiB of old temporary outputs, which ongoing cache generation consumed again. Add a user-visible cache budget/eviction and reclamation strategy that does not require a full temporary copy of the database for VACUUM. Current performance work adds a 1 GiB low-space admission guard, scoped temporary cleanup, and fatal-write handling, but does not delete persistent cached terrain or source data.
notes: Archive packing also competes for remaining capacity: Hilbert vector sources total 19.89 GB across 77,053 cells; duplication across eighth-degree tiles and SQLite overhead can exceed the ~23.8 GB free during full packing. 1kee-mgw adds actual destination-size/free-space reporting and a best-effort 1 GiB reserve, but does not shrink archives. Further work needs reliable footprint forecasting, space-efficient packed payloads evaluated against runtime read latency, and safe incremental migration/reclamation without deleting source data prematurely. notes: Hardened the AISStream path by accepting both Metadata/MetaData payload variants and changed empty-ship logging to explicitly call out the current viewport, so a quiet inland focus no longer looks like a broken API key.

title: Replace temporary aircraft provider and finish ship ingest
description: Swap the temporary OpenSky aircraft adapter to a more practical provider such as airplanes.live or another affordable ADS-B source, and finish the AIS ship ingest path so the moving-track layers are usable without placeholder status.
notes: Adjusted ship polling to use a wider bbox than aircraft in local/regional mode. Ships were already rendered in the regional scene, but the AIS subscription bounds were shrinking with the terrain camera and dropping nearby coastal traffic. The renderer now receives a broader vessel feed while keeping aircraft tied to the tighter viewport bounds.

title: Integrate terrain asset discovery and preprocessing plan
description: Detect local GEBCO, Natural Earth, and SRTM assets from the Data directory, surface their status in the UI, and document the preprocessing pipeline for globe terrain/contour generation.
notes: Scanning local terrain datasets and wiring a manifest/status layer into the app. Also documenting the GDAL preprocessing path for GEBCO, Natural Earth, and the partially present SRTM mirror.
close_reason: Completed terrain asset discovery and preprocessing planning: detected local GEBCO, Natural Earth, and partial SRTM assets from Data/, surfaced terrain status in the UI model/header, documented the GDAL pipeline, and verified with cargo check.

title: Upgrade globe to interactive 3D camera with contour-driven LOD
description: Replace the static orthographic globe behavior with drag/scroll camera controls, zoom-based level of detail, and a contour-heavy 3D-first rendering language aligned with the target visual references.
notes: Implementing persistent globe camera state, drag/scroll interaction, zoom-dependent LOD, and a more contour-heavy 3D renderer. Also fixing terrain inventory discovery so the app can find Data/ from nested working directories.
close_reason: Completed the 3D globe interaction slice: added persistent camera state, drag orbit, wheel zoom, zoom-driven LOD, procedural contour-heavy globe rendering, and terrain discovery that works from nested working directories. Verified with cargo check.

title: Generate derived terrain assets from local datasets
description: Use the checked-in GEBCO and Natural Earth source rasters to build runtime-friendly derived assets under Derived/terrain, starting with a global VRT, preview raster, and contour outputs.
notes: Generating derived terrain assets under Derived/terrain from the local GEBCO and Natural Earth sources so the next globe pass can consume real preprocessed data instead of only procedural contours.
close_reason: Generated derived terrain assets from local GEBCO and Natural Earth sources: global VRT, 4096x2048 GEBCO preview raster, 500m and 200m contour GeoPackages, and Natural Earth relief preview. Validated outputs with gdalinfo/ogrinfo and documented the results.

title: Integrate derived GEBCO preview into globe renderer
description: Load the generated GEBCO preview raster as a runtime terrain asset and drive globe elevation/shading from real sampled terrain instead of the current procedural field.
notes: Integrated the derived GEBCO preview runtime asset into the globe renderer via a cached PNG sampler. The renderer now samples real terrain height when the runtime asset is present and falls back to the procedural field otherwise.
close_reason: Integrated the derived GEBCO preview runtime asset into the globe renderer: generated runtime PNG assets, added a cached terrain sampler, and switched globe elevation sampling from procedural-only to asset-backed with fallback. Verified with cargo check.

title: Add data-root picker and ingest derived contour vectors
description: Let the operator choose the project data root explicitly from the desktop UI and begin consuming derived GEBCO contour assets from that selected root for globe rendering.
notes: Adding direct vector-cell cache writes for the Overpass focused-road path so preferred Overpass imports populate the same reusable road cache as osmium instead of only feeding the SQLite tile store.

title: Verify agent proxies the video carrier (WS-upstream vs chunked HTTP)
close_reason: Superseded: surface streaming should not be solved per-app. Encode/transport/input/consent belong in gruve-kit or the agent. Findings + design captured in docs/gruve-native-app-streaming.md

title: Perf C: hoist per-frame allocs (factal key, stellar GMST)
close_reason: Verified: stellar GMST already computed once before the loop (stellar_layer.rs:31); factal key.to_owned() is a deliberate ~50B alloc avoiding a borrow conflict, not worth restructuring. No change needed.

title: 3DEP 1m elevation integration
description: Integrate USGS 3DEP 1m bare-earth DEM into 1kEE via on-demand ImageServer clips (no bulk mirror). Feeds deep-zoom contours, elevation sampling, and a hillshade layer.
close_reason: 3DEP integrated: on-demand acquisition, deep zoom tiers 7-10, elevation sampling, hillshade layer

title: Fix globe rendering performance and zoom
close_reason: All fixes committed

title: Profile local terrain contour fallback under large overlay imports
Fix lunar local zoom hangs from source chunk contention
description: Moon Mode local view can stall indefinitely at tighter zooms because multiple lunar tile builds race on the same cached source chunk. Add chunk-level dedupe/locking and safe temp-file handling in the desktop GDAL path.
notes: Added chunk-level dedupe/waiting around lunar source chunk creation in desktop GDAL path and switched chunk temp files to unique names so neighboring lunar tiles no longer race on the same missing chunk. Verified with cargo fmt and cargo check -p one-thousand-electric-eye-desktop.
close_reason: Deduplicated lunar source chunk builds and temp files in desktop GDAL path; desktop crate compiles.
